data.one_liner: Dart FFI bindings for liboqs enabling post-quantum cryptography primitives like ML-KEM and ML-DSA.
data.what_it_does: Provides high-performance post-quantum cryptography (PQC) key encapsulation and signature primitives in Dart via FFI bindings to liboqs. It supports dynamic library loading across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux, and offers constant-time comparison methods to prevent timing side-channels.
use_when: You need post-quantum key encapsulation mechanisms (ML-KEM, Falcon) in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want post-quantum digital signatures with optional context-aware parameters.
avoid_when: You cannot include native binaries or build the required liboqs native library for your deployment target.
strengths: High-performance post-quantum cryptography support via native liboqs bindings.
Cross-platform support covering Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Includes constant-time comparison methods to guard against timing side-channels.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup and management of native liboqs binaries for each target platform.
Changes upstream in liboqs (such as breaking name changes or removed algorithms) directly impact the Dart API behavior.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining and setting up a native liboqs dynamic library or XCFramework for each target platform (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux).
